explicacion.que_cambiar: Open with the shot of stale bread next to soft bread and the text “3 tricks to keep your bread from going stale”; the greeting goes after the first trick.

apertura.titulo: Made-up example: three tricks to keep sweet bread from going stale

antes.voz: Hi everyone, how are you? I'm Zoe Quintanar and welcome to today's kitchen. Today I want to talk about something that happens to all of us at home. It's about sweet bread. The first trick: keep it in a cloth bag, never in plastic.

despues.voz: Keeping sweet bread from going stale comes down to three tricks. One is to keep it in a cloth bag, never in plastic. Next is where to store it.
cuadros: A round loaf of sweet bread centered large on a wooden kitchen counter, filling most of the frame with its golden sugared top visible.
A cloth bag on the same kitchen counter with the sweet bread half inside, the bag open and resting flat.
An open kitchen pantry shelf with containers and empty space where the cloth bag can be stored, soft light on the tidy area.
